title: A Salt for the Crown
author: Ines Crane
blurb: Lena Zhou, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
